function.name: game_functions_solve_jigsaw
function.description: Generate solution for a given jigsaw puzzle image. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

puzzle_image.description: The image file of the jigsaw puzzle.

pieces_count.description: Number of pieces in the jigsaw puzzle.

solve_method.description: Method to be used to solve the puzzle. Default is brute_force.

message.content: I’m happy to help with jigsaw puzzles, but I don’t have a built‑in tool for generating new puzzle images. If you already have an image you’d like to turn into a puzzle, let me know the file (or a link to it) and how many pieces you’d like, and I can run the solver for you. If you’re looking for instructions on how to create a puzzle yourself, I can walk you through the steps—just let me know what you have in mind!
